items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: I've been with Paul ever since. ... Oh, I'm with Paul now. About eight years. ... I think that was one of the first jobs I played with Paul.

ctx.x: I never heard him on clarinet. I heard him on records with P-Rom and alto.

Well, he blowed nice clarinet, too. In other words, him and Willie used to double at one time on clarinet. He was a very good friend of William Humphrey. And, uh, from then, I scouted around with P-Rom. Played with P-Rom a while. After Louie Warnick died, the band broke up. Played with P-Rom. And up until he's dead. And, uh, ended up with Paul. I've been with Paul ever since.
How many years have you been with Paul? Paul, right?
